$doc: Glyph manifest for the self-hosted Roboto woff2 subsets (web/public/fonts/*.woff2). Each [lo, hi] pair is an inclusive DECIMAL codepoint range kept in the subset; single glyphs are one-element pairs. This reproduces the coverage of the original hand-made subsets (extracted from their cmaps 2026-07-28): printable ASCII, Latin-1 supplement, Greek, general punctuation, and the math operators Roboto ships. Glyphs OUTSIDE this set (▲ ✓ ★ ⓘ §-adjacent symbols, emoji) intentionally fall back per-glyph — the @font-face unicode-range in web/src/styles.css is generated from this file so out-of-subset glyphs fall through to the next family in the stack. Regenerate: npm run fonts:subsets (script: scripts/subset-fonts.ts).
